xmldoc.short_description: Keep only some signals of a record already read.

param_input_item.param_description: the signals to keep, by label (a char or a cellstr) or by index, in the order asked.

param_output_item.param_description: the same struct with only the chosen signals, in the order asked.

description.p: Keeps only some signals of the struct R from wfdb.read, by label or by index. The header, the annotations and everything else are left as they are; only the signals array is narrowed and the multiFrequency flag recomputed, so a record read once can be cut down without reading it again. A label that is not a signal, or an index out of range, is refused rather than read as a silent empty.
